update.summary: Merge native LoopRD Social v0.2.1 backend and Tauri Windows/Android client into one repository/ZipRunner project; retain SQLite schema and action protocol; support persistent server-side numeric portrait codes without schema migration; add unified CI and workflows.

planned_work.title: Store shared Portrait Library 3 codes in Social profiles
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: With a deployed LoopRD Social 0.2.2 component, save a numeric portrait from Windows and confirm Android reads the same code after login.

planned_work.title: Integrated cross-platform Social client
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: After ZipRunner update, check server/looprd_handler.py, looprd.yaml and client/src/main.js are all present.

planned_work.title: Social lobby and profile client integration
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Connect via a deployed LoopRD origin and provisioned development token, then send a lobby message.

planned_work.title: Optional game turn alerts
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Test with a game implementing activity/v1 and grant desktop/mobile notification permission.

planned_work.title: Portrait generator source and asset compatibility
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Run npm run portrait:sync inside client with network access, create a portrait and save it to Social.

planned_work.title: Single-project ZipRunner package and GitHub workflows
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Import looprd-social-0.2.2-ziprunner.zip into existing looprd-social ZipRunner project.

planned_work.title: Integrated backend and client protocol tests
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Run npm run test and python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -v.

planned_work.title: Production-ready Social authentication and trusted game invitations
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Replace development-only tokens with Social-owned, verified and revocable device sessions, game-specific trust and invitation contract. An external OIDC provider is NOT required.

planned_work.title: Server-backed friends and private conversations
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Extend Social component to support game-oriented friends, private/group chat and permissions without changing LoopRD domain logic.

planned_work.title: Background Android push and turn notification delivery
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Current local alerts work only while app is running; require implementer-owned device registration and push provider for terminated apps.

planned_work.title: GitHub native build and device acceptance
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Run Windows NSIS and Android ARM64 APK workflows in GitHub; install and test on devices. Local source test is not native compilation.

planned_work.title: Game component activity integration
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Implement the optional game-specific activity/v1 contract in supported game components; existing games may not expose it yet.
